name: crm-modernia-limpio
description: Development tooling for CRM Modernia Limpio

scripts.lint:js: eslint web/app.js web/app-auth.js web/app-routing.js web/app_shared.js web/ui-foundation.js web/sw.js
scripts.lint:js:quiet: eslint --quiet web/app.js web/app-auth.js web/app-routing.js web/app_shared.js web/ui-foundation.js web/sw.js
scripts.lint:js:fix: eslint --fix web/app.js web/app-auth.js web/app-routing.js web/app_shared.js web/ui-foundation.js web/sw.js
scripts.security:semgrep: mkdir -p .semgrep && SSL_CERT_FILE=$(python -c 'import certifi; print(certifi.where())') REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=$(python -c 'import certifi; print(certifi.where())') SEMGREP_LOG_FILE=.semgrep/semgrep.log SEMGREP_SETTINGS_FILE=.semgrep/settings.yml SEMGREP_VERSION_CACHE_PATH=.semgrep/version-cache python -c "from semgrep.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" scan --config .semgrep.yml --error --metrics=off -j 1
